input: Interview three wedding photographers this month

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The wedding date and location determine whether photographers are available and whether local vs. destination photographers should be targeted.
The photography budget sets the tier of photographers to approach and eliminates candidates immediately if their rates are out of range.
Knowing what coverage is needed (ceremony only, full day, engagement shoot, etc.) affects what questions to ask and what packages to compare.
Whether the user is doing this alone or with a partner changes how decisions are made and whether both need to be present at interviews.
Photography style preference (e.g., documentary, fine art, traditional) is the single biggest filter for which photographers to shortlist.
Whether interviews happen in person, by video call, or by phone affects scheduling complexity and how soon the first one can realistically be booked.
Understanding what the user most wants to walk away with — a signed contract, a shortlist, a gut-check — defines what a successful interview actually looks like.

gold.taskTitle: Interview three wedding photographers this month
gold.taskDescription: Research and conduct interviews with three wedding photographers within the current month to help choose the right one to hire.

questions.title: What is your wedding date and general location?
questions.description: The wedding date and location determine photographer availability and whether to search locally or for destination photographers.

questions.title: What is your total budget for wedding photography?
questions.description: The budget sets the price tier of photographers to approach and helps eliminate out-of-range candidates immediately.

questions.title: What coverage do you need from a photographer?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the user needs full-day coverage, ceremony only, an engagement shoot add-on, or a second shooter — shaping what packages to compare across interviews.

questions.title: Will you be interviewing together with a partner?
questions.description: Knowing who else is involved determines scheduling logistics and whether consensus needs to be built across both decision-makers.

questions.title: What photography style are you drawn to most?
questions.description: Style preference (e.g., documentary, fine art, editorial, traditional) is the primary filter for building the shortlist of photographers to contact.

questions.title: Do you prefer to meet in person, by video, or by phone?
questions.description: The interview format affects scheduling complexity, how quickly the first meeting can be arranged, and what preparation is needed.

questions.title: What does a successful interview result look like for you?
questions.description: Defines the end goal — whether the user wants to sign a contract immediately after, narrow to a final pick, or simply get a feel for each photographer's personality and work.
